description: This file defines a serializer and copier for the Uri type within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing Uri objects to a wire protocol, handling references, and ensuring proper serialization semantics.

classes.name: UriCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the Uri type, implementing reading and writing logic for serialization.

classes.name: UriCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for Uri objects, used for object duplication within the serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a Uri value from the serialization buffer, handling references and raw string deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a Uri value to the serialization buffer, including reference handling and string serialization.

methods.name: WriteField (static)
methods.description: Writes a Uri value without type info, assuming the expected type is known at compile time.
